injuries.comment: Dream head coach Karl Smesko told reporters Sunday that Jones does not have a timetable of return for a left leg injury, WNBA reporter Kareem Copeland reports.
Maly (coach's decision) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Golden State.
Carrington is out for Friday's game against the Valkyries due to a left foot injury.
Diggins (knee) is out for Monday's game against the Storm.
The Sky announced Tuesday that Jackson will miss the remainder of the season after suffering a torn ACL in her left knee during Sunday's 86-79 win over the Lynx.
Edwards (ankle) is listed as out for Saturday's game against the Sparks.
Griner (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Sparks.
Williams (coach's decision) is out for Thursday's game against the Fever.
Jones (coach's decision) won't play Thursday against the Fever.
Fudd will undergo an arthroscopic procedure to address her right knee soreness and will be sidelined for the remainder of the 2026 season.
James (leg) is not with the team and is without a timetable for a return to game action, Christan Braswell of Off The Record WBB reports.
Verona's contract was temporarily suspended by the Wings Saturday.
Rupert is pregnant, and the Valkyries have filed for a replacement contract ahead of the 2026 season, Alexa Philippou of ESPN.com reports Thursday.
Clark (back) is probable for Saturday's game against the Liberty.
Boston (lower leg) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Liberty.
Dantas underwent left knee surgery Tuesday and will miss the remainder of the 2026 season, the Fever announced.
Latson (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game against Connecticut.
Evans (leg) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Connecticut.
Atkins (head) is practicing with the Sparks on Saturday morning, John W. Davis of Long Beach Press-Telegram reports.

Williams sustained an apparent lower right leg injury in the final minute of Friday's 94-84 win over the Mystics, per Mitchell Hansen of CanisHoopus.com. She finished with 13 points (5-11 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 2-2 FT), eight assists, six rebounds and one steal in 31 minutes.
King (coach's decision) is out for Friday's game against the Mystics.
Buenavida (coach's decision) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Mystics.
Collier (rest) is out for Friday's game against the Mystics.

Fiebich (foot) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Fever.
Jones (ankle) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Fever.
Plum (calf) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Dream.
Nogic (not injury related) intends to play professionally in Russia and won't return to Phoenix this season, Aya Abdeen of TheIXSports.com reports.
Geiselsoder (personal) won't return this season, according to Sean Highkin of RoseGardenReport.com.
The Fire announced Friday that Barker will undergo surgery to repair a torn ACL and will miss the remainder of the 2026 campaign.
Feagin (knee) was diagnosed with a torn left ACL on Thursday and will miss the rest of the 2026 campaign, WNBA reporter Kareem Copeland reports.

Hiedeman is out for Sunday's game against Chicago due to a left shoulder injury.
Morrow (knee) won't return to Friday's game against Portland, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet reports. She went scoreless (0-2 FG, 0-1 3Pt), adding two rebounds.
Sykes (foot) won't return to Friday's game versus the Fire, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet reports. She went scoreless (0-1 FG) over two minutes.
Green (coach's decision) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Fire.
Mabrey (adductor) is out for Friday's game against the Fire.
Conde (calf) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Fire.
Sabally (calf) is in a walking boot and will be re-evaluated in "a few weeks," Chelsea Leite of TSN reports.
